entries.name: False Light
entries.description: Gold relief floods the wounds and sharpens the hand. It is not a gift. It is a loan.

entries.name: Reckoning
entries.description: The light collects. Hands shake, eyes swim, every motion is late.

entries.name: Dissolution
entries.description: Nyx's veil thins too far; form and guard fray together.

entries.name: Isolation
entries.description: Eris's edge cuts you off from rest and mending.

entries.name: Exposure
entries.description: The Eye stays open both ways; you are seen and struck more easily.

entries.name: Monopolized Sight
entries.description: A grey fog closes in; only what is within arm's reach remains clear.

entries.name: Confessor's Clarity
entries.description: The glass cuts through veil and fog alike.

entries.name: Ophite Insight
entries.description: You see the seam in every guard before it closes.

entries.name: Broken Halo's Ward
entries.description: Snapped iron still remembers how to turn a blow.

entries.name: Sundered
entries.description: Armor split along the seam; blows bite deeper.

entries.name: Braced
entries.description: Stance anchored against the worst.

entries.name: Apostate Focus
entries.description: Unfettered from the wheel; every stroke lands harder.

entries.name: Veiled
entries.description: Step and silhouette slip out of the eye.

entries.name: Bleeding
entries.description: An arterial cut drains vitality every turn.

entries.name: Burning
entries.description: Cinder-fire clings to cloth and bone, searing every turn.

entries.name: Chilled
entries.description: Ossuary frost stiffens the limbs and slows every step.

entries.name: Pinned
entries.description: Shackled in place; unable to walk free until the bond breaks.

entries.name: Hexed
entries.description: The Geometry turns hostile: Void and Radiant blows bite 25% deeper.

entries.name: Crown's Decree
entries.description: Authority sharpens the strike and steels against the false sun.

entries.name: Keeper's Vigil
entries.description: Calm wick-light pierces darkness, fire, and grave-frost.

entries.name: Almoner's Debt
entries.description: Measured breath mends wounds and hastens the step.

entries.name: Induced Debility
entries.description: The chain saps strength and aim.

entries.name: Dread
entries.description: A threat lands; every motion flinches.

entries.name: Degraded
entries.description: Worn down and marked as lesser; guard and vigor fray.

entries.name: Trivial Demand
entries.description: A petty order consumes your focus; resource will not recover.

entries.name: Entangled
entries.description: The Subjugation clock closes: slowed, exposed, and bound.

entries.name: Forsworn
entries.description: A broken oath; the Geometry withdraws its favor.

entries.name: Return-Oriented
entries.description: Your steps lean toward the Way of Return: chains tighten more slowly.

entries.name: Serpent's Seam
entries.description: Your steps lean toward the Serpent's Way: you strike through seams in the ledger.

entries.name: Sovereign's Mark
entries.description: Unchecked power sharpens you, and the order of Rex Mundi marks you for it.

entries.name: Boon of the Fast
entries.description: Clear-eyed from fasting.

entries.name: Boon of Poverty
entries.description: Unburdened and hard to hold.

entries.name: Boon of the Taken Name
entries.description: A name nobody wrote down.

entries.name: Boon of the Crown Taken
entries.description: Borrowed sovereignty hardens the hand.

entries.name: Sanctuary Ward
entries.description: Consecrated shelter steadies your pulse against dominion light and abyssal glare.

entries.name: Iron-Tempered Skin
entries.description: Flesh hardens like cold foundry iron against edge and bolt.

entries.name: Litany of Haste
entries.description: Footwork outpaces the sentry's cadence.

entries.name: Quiet Shroud
entries.description: Sound and outline blur along the cellar flagstones.

entries.name: Witness Clarity
entries.description: Sharpens eye and judgment through smoke and ledger-ink.

entries.name: Temperance Ward
entries.description: Salt and wormwood dull ember, frost, and void.

entries.name: Iron Fervor
entries.description: Trade caution for fierce striking force.

entries.name: Scourge's Fervor
entries.description: Old penitential discipline turns pain into merciless precision.

entries.name: Indexed Sight
entries.description: Secret seams and ledger ink stand out against the stone.

entries.name: Cinder Mantle
entries.description: Dry sanctuary embers armor you against burn and chill alike.

entries.name: Toll of Frost
entries.description: One bronze stroke stills adjacent limbs and frost-proofs the bearer.

entries.name: Margin's Shield
entries.description: For a brief span the Dominion's audit skips your name.

entries.name: Brass Sovereign
entries.description: A counterfeit solar stamp bends false light into striking edge.

entries.name: Borrowed Breath
entries.description: Fine pale salt quickens every pace inside the cellar.

entries.name: Cadence Unbroken
entries.description: True pitch steadies Will and cuts through choir wards.

entries.name: Gatekeeper's Lock
entries.description: Heavy iron wards anchor your stance in the breach.

entries.name: Mirrored Gaze
entries.description: Reflections strip the fog and reveal weak joints.
